goal: Find independently runnable or substantially complete railway operational scenario datasets, not only specifications
qualification: Complete means complete for the listed scenario boundary. None of these is a complete certified ETCS Level 2 TMS→IXL→RBC→OBU integration.
files_in_git: For source material with confirmed GNU GPL-3.0 rights, two configuration seeds may be included unmodified, with original license and provenance. All other sources are links to be fetched under their own conditions.

datasources.title: OSM Interlocking – locking table reference application
coverage: config: 2 routes, 2 points, 5 zones, 14 transits, 3 signals
missing_for_complete_etcs_l2: no ETCS OBU or actual RBC
no general-purpose train timetable/TMS
datasources.notes: Full repo ZIP includes design grammars, rules and simulator; source configuration JSON separately copied under dataset-seeds/.

datasources.title: OSM Interlocking – geographical interlocking reference application
coverage: 2 sample routes, 2 points, 5 track zones, 14 transits
missing_for_complete_etcs_l2: no OBU/radio/RBC implementation
does not include operational timetable
datasources.notes: Shared repo with locking-table sample; one archive serves both.

datasources.title: OSRD small_infra RailJSON test infrastructure
missing_for_complete_etcs_l2: stock and timetable must be paired from OSRD test resources
not a complete software interlocking state machine
no ETCS OBU/RBC
datasources.notes: 195092-byte source JSON inspected via GitHub; examples and stock import instructions in OSRD README.

datasources.title: DISPLIB Norwegian full-day dispatching problems
coverage: Norwegian lines with timetable, resources, headways and delayed-train rescheduling problems
Jærbanen 120 km / 28 stations with full-day demand
test instances and independently verifiable dispatch solutions
missing_for_complete_etcs_l2: no route-control interlocking circuits or signal hardware model
resource/operation graph is not a detailed physical track model
no ETCS
datasources.notes: Public test instances include smi and nor; source specifies all-scenarios archive and solution checker.

datasources.title: DISPLIB Siemens Mobility Italy dispatching problems
coverage: resources, train operations and best-known outcomes
missing_for_complete_etcs_l2: no train dynamics and ETCS messages
no executable physical interlocking
datasources.notes: Same archive as DISPLIB-NOR; variety of difficulties, 5-13 trains in listed examples.

datasources.title: railML.org Simple Example v11, interlocking included
datasources.licence: railML restricted CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 plus additional terms
coverage: interlocking routes and overlaps, release groups
missing_for_complete_etcs_l2: source notes file may contain errors
no complete timetable/physical OBU
datasources.notes: 3 routes, 3 switches, 13 signals and 13 track-vacancy detection sections reported in published academic case study. Do not rehost.

datasources.title: Santpoort-Noord Dutch station formalised interlocking dataset

datasources.title: GICSAFePhD 8 railML layouts and auto-derived interlocking tables

missing_for_complete_etcs_l2: no train timetable, RBC or full OBU
rights and precise files to validate

datasources.title: Logic Navigator Generic Complete Railway Stations
